print window: all caricatures, 4 per sheet, straight to the printer
eval: return (async()=>{ window.__myphotocut.actions.updateSettings({ language: 'ko' }); window.__myphotocut.run('print'); for (let i=0;i<60 && !document.querySelector('.web-popup-print iframe')?.contentDocument?.querySelector('.print-sheet .print-page');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); let d=document.querySelector('.web-popup-print iframe').contentDocument; const sel=d.querySelector('[data-print="scope"]'); sel.value='all'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); for (let i=0;i<240;i++) { d=document.querySelector('.web-popup-print iframe').contentDocument; if (d.querySelectorAll('.print-sheet .print-page').length>1) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } d.querySelector('[data-print-segment="perPage"][data-value="4"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); d=document.querySelector('.web-popup-print iframe').contentDocument; const pages=d.querySelectorAll('.print-sheet .print-page').length; if (pages!==10) throw new Error('sheets '+pages); let job=null; const w=document.querySelector('.web-popup-print iframe').contentWindow; w.__myphotocutPrintHook=async(l,j)=>{job=j;}; d.querySelector('[data-action="print"]').click(); for (let i=0;i<40 && !job;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (!job) throw new Error('nothing printed'); window.__myphotocut.popups.close('print'); return pages+' sheets, A4 '+job.widthMm+'x'+job.heightMm; })()

name: fit exaggeration to this face
eval: return (async()=>{ const a=window.__myphotocut.actions; const s=window.__myphotocut.state; a.select(s.doc.items[2].id); a.warpPreset('style'); const before=s.doc.items[2].warp.nose; a.warpPreset('personal'); await a.idle(); const { standoutFeatures } = await import('/src/engine/face.js'); return 'stands out: '+standoutFeatures(s.doc.features).map(x=>x.key+' '+(x.percent>0?'+':'')+x.percent+'%').join(', ')+'; nose '+before+' -> '+s.doc.items[2].warp.nose; })()
